title: Address PR #383 bot findings in seed.ts
description:
Fix GitHub bot findings on dashboard/amplify/seed/seed.ts from PR #383:
- remove unused `user` binding when creating seed user
- replace SHA-256 password hashing used for username derivation with a stronger KDF-based derivation to satisfy CodeQL (insufficient computational effort).

Validation: run amplify TypeScript compile.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Implemented both PR #383 bot fixes in `dashboard/amplify/seed/seed.ts`:

- Removed unused variable binding by changing `const user = await createAndSignUpUser(...)` to `await createAndSignUpUser(...)`.
- Replaced `createHash('sha256')` password-derived username hash with `scryptSync(..., "plexus-sandbox-seed-user", 16)` to use a KDF and address CodeQL computational-effort finding.

Validation:
- `cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit -p amplify/tsconfig.json` passed.
